_about: PARSA s14 (D-365): licensed 3D scans and sculpts used as the monuments' source meshes. Each file is fetched by tools/blender/scans/scanlib.ts scanFile() from `url` (the Objaverse 1.0 mirror of the Sketchfab model on Hugging Face: no login) into $FARS_SCANS (default C:/Users/Administrator/fars-assets/scans_s14; not in git) and checked against sha256. Every one is recorded in ASSET_LEDGER.md.

lamassu_hp.author: Shahriar Shahrabi (@shahriyarshahrabi)
lamassu_hp.what: Persian lamassu (human-headed winged bull) of the Gate of All Nations, a digital sculpt by the author: an Assyrian lamassu as the base, adjusted after the damaged Persepolis original (larger, bent wings, the Persian crown, the front). Tier C (a modern reconstruction of the carving, not a scan of the stone).
